description: This file defines a React component for a 'Doctor View' interface, allowing users (presumably doctors) to create and sign prescriptions, manage patient details, and view local prescription history. It includes state management, event handlers, and UI elements, and interfaces with external wallet and storage libraries.

methods.name: canonicalMessage
methods.description: Create a canonical JSON string of the prescription payload for signing.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Connect to a user's Solana wallet and set the wallet public key.

methods.name: onSign
methods.description: Sign the prescription data with the wallet, save it locally, and reset the form.
